front: Why one step gives the mean
back: With crossing paths the field at noise is the average direction; one step moves every point to the data mean.

front: Stable trace of the matrix square root
back: Sum of square roots of the eigenvalues of $\Sigma_r^{1/2}\Sigma_g\Sigma_r^{1/2}$ (symmetric PSD).
